 virtual function void
 svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_monitor_callback::lane_transaction_observed_cov
 (  svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_monitor ppi_mon , svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction lane_xact  ) 

Callback issued by the component to allow the testbench to collect functional coverage information from a Lane Transaction that it just received. This is called by the component immediately before placing the Lane Transaction into the output.

ppi_mon - A reference to the component object issuing this callback. User's callback implementation can use this to access the public data and/or methods of the component.

lane_xact - A reference to the svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction descriptor object of interest.

 virtual function void
 svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_monitor_callback::pre_lane_transaction_observed_put
 (  svt_mipi_cphy_ppi_monitor ppi_mon , svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction lane_xact , ref bit drop  ) 

Callback issued by the component after recognizing a Lane Transaction, just prior to placing the Lane Transaction in the output.

ppi_mon - A reference to the component object issuing this callback.

lane_xact - A reference to the svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction descriptor object of interest.

drop - A ref argument that, if set by the user's callback implementation, causes the component to discard the svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction descriptor without further action.
